app.title: dnd-platform
app.tagline: A character-first D&D 5e platform for newcomers.

packages.heading: Packages
packages.intro: A package is a set of rules content: classes, species, spells, items. The SRD 5.1 comes with the site and is always here. You can add your own packages, homebrew or books you own, from a file: they are checked, kept in this browser only, and never sent anywhere.

load.heading: Add a package
load.hint: Choose the .zip of a package folder, or a .json bundle. You can choose several files at once.
load.remarks: Show the remark | Show the {count} remarks
load.refused: {file} is not a valid package, so it was not added.
load.refusedNext: Fix the problems below and add it again, or ask whoever gave it to you for a corrected file.
load.problems: Show the problem | Show the {count} problems
load.failed: {file} could not be read: it may not be a .zip or a .json file.

remove.confirm: Remove {name} from this browser? You can add it again from its file.
remove.inUse: {name} is used by {characters}: remove or change those characters first.

storage.heading: Storage on this device
storage.persisted: This browser keeps your packages and characters.
storage.notPersisted: This browser may delete your packages and characters when it runs short of space.
storage.unknown: This browser does not say whether it keeps your packages and characters.
storage.safari: Safari deletes the data of sites you have not opened for a few weeks. Keep the files of your packages; exporting characters to a file comes with a next version.

characters.heading: Characters
characters.intro: Your characters will live here: creating one with guidance arrives with the next versions. Meanwhile, open one of the demo characters to see how a sheet explains every number.

notFound.heading: Character not found
notFound.text: There is no character with this address in this browser.

missing.heading: Content not installed here
missing.text: This character uses content that is not installed here: the package {id}. Load it on the Packages page, then come back.
